title: Finding Acquisition Targets
answer: Finding acquisition targets in private equity and deal sourcing means identifying companies that fit a fund's thesis, size, sector and value creation plan. It covers both proprietary outreach and intermediated processes, and it spans public comparables, private company databases and relationship networks. The output is a shortlist with enough evidence to justify diligence, not a valuation or a binding offer. In AI-related sectors, scope also includes understanding whether the target's data, models and talent are durable assets or easily replicated.

sections.body: Finding acquisition targets in private equity and deal sourcing means identifying companies that fit a fund's thesis, size, sector and value creation plan. It covers both proprietary outreach and intermediated processes, and it spans public comparables, private company databases and relationship networks. sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: Deal sourcing runs on data sources such as company registries, financial filings, market data, CRM systems and relationship graphs. For AI targets, infrastructure also includes technical signals such as model repositories, API usage, patent filings and compute spend. The site's 117 listed AI-related instruments with daily prices can serve as a public market reference for sector sentiment and comparable multiples. Teams typically combine a deal pipeline CRM with screening tools and alerting on funding rounds, leadership changes and M&A filings.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: The method starts with a thesis and a screening funnel, then moves to long lists, short lists and outreach. Sourcing teams use Boolean searches, database filters, conference lists, expert calls and inbound referrals to build a candidate set. For AI targets, technical diligence screens may include code repository activity, benchmark results, data rights and key person dependencies. The site's 355 merger and acquisition filings can be used to study precedent transactions and buyer behavior.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: Governance covers data provenance, confidentiality, insider information and conflicts of interest. Sourcing teams are bound by contractual restrictions on data use, privacy laws and market abuse rules when they gather signals from public and private sources. The site's 148 active AI lawsuits and 219 compliance and regulation pages illustrate the legal and regulatory exposure that can attach to AI targets, from intellectual property disputes to data protection claims. Provenance matters because a target's training data, model weights and licenses may not be cleanly documented.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: Deal sourcing is moving toward more automated screening, continuous monitoring and AI-assisted matching of targets to thesis criteria. The field is seeing more use of alternative data, such as developer activity, cloud spend and patent signals, to surface companies earlier. At the same time, regulation and litigation are making provenance and compliance checks a larger part of the early screen. The human work shifts from list building to judgment about fit, timing and whether a target's AI advantage is defensible.
